decisions.reason: The hearty bread runs on existing lines at almost no extra cost, and with no website evidence since 2019 there is no clear signal of failure, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
The mill tour was likely hit by pandemic restrictions, but it uses existing heritage facilities at low holding cost and its demand could recover as hospitality reopens, so it is kept as an option.
The sweet pastry fits the core range and is cheap to sustain, and no negative result has emerged, so abandoning it is not justified.
The farmhouse bread sits close to the firm's established offer with low marginal cost, and there is too little evidence to judge its value, so the option stays open.
The gold award has largely resolved the uncertainty in its favour, so the flagship poppy seed stollen deserves further commitment rather than abandonment.
The gold-awarded premium stollen shows its value as a seasonal and gift product, so it should be kept and built upon.
